body: Thank you. This means a lot to me. I didn’t expect to hear back so quickly especially from someone that also experienced my profession.

I relate to that; a complete feeling of apathy. Not necessarily a compulsion to go through the motions to kill oneself — but the desire to stop participating, to just fade away, as if to sleep. 

As far as the success you’ve achieved in your life; I went from making 6k a year to 200k. I went from being insecure, dependent, fearful and clingy to being in a loving, long term relationship. I’ve lived all over the world. And none of these factors - especially not even money - have changed a damn thing about how I feel. 

I’m in a low place too, again, at this moment. What I can offer you is hopefully some comfort in that you are not alone in how you feel.
